system.description:
Self-taught, with no institution's name behind them — closer kin to Fort Dunwell's "outlaw wizard" than to any tower.

  • Unexpected Caster: The first harmful spell you cast in a combat where the enemy doesn't expect you to be a caster imposes Disadvantage on their saving throw against it.
  • Make It Work: Advantage on checks scrounging, improvising, or substituting spell components on the fly.
